title: Tech. Sgt. Stanley Recovers His Uniform Shirt from Tornado Victim, Package
description: Tech. Sgt. Drew Stanley assists with Moore tornado victims. Having lent a victim the shirt off his back, she gives it back in the hospital. Produced by Master Sgt. Vincent Donaldson. Includes interviews with Ms. Sandra Adams, 65, of Moore, Okla., Tech. Sgt. Drew Stanley, air cargo specialist for the Logistical Readiness Squadron, 137th Air refueling Wing, Oklahoma Air National Guard.
keywords: oklahoma tornado, Moore Oklahoma, Drew Stanley, Sandra Adams
